artboards.title: Provenance — where the negative space lives

annotations.text:
One rendering rule, both ends of it:

· Content shows ONLY mandates (cited cards), real local choices, and pointer cards. Silent fields render nowhere on Content — a wired guardrail appears only when true.

· The same rule that gives Texas three cards gives Florida its honest empty state plus the one genuine choice silence leaves open (offer a waiver at all — recording NO completes the section).

· Include-by-evidence: no per-state display code, no EXCLUDE flags to curate.

Negative-finding records (decided direction, 2026-08-27): the library gains { no_provision, researched, note } entries per concept, imported as field provenance. They distinguish "researched — the state says nothing" from "nobody looked", drive the same pruning, and give the auditor a receipt in the Provenance zone. Authoring lands in the research pipeline, not in app code.

Build implications: display-only pruning + a provenance renderer; the 22-field store is untouched. One real behavior change: a recorded "no waiver" must count as CONFIGURED (today only enabled:true does) — same fix pattern as clarification. The window card renders from the template's figures until the reconciler fills the null fields.
